text:
Situation: Sufentanil citrate remains in shortage per FDA records first posted 2022-05-03 and current as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 64 vials (7.1 days); Corvale General holds 134 vials (16.1 days); Corvale Lakeside holds 50 vials (21.4 days). The product used at both Corvale sites carries NDC 00409338221, labeled by Hospira, Inc. at FEI 1021343.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the shortage on 2022-05-03 and it remains current as of 2026-10-21. Additional OAI inspections occurred on 2011-06-17 and 2011-08-04, and a Warning Letter was issued on 2010-04-12. The most recent inspection of the plant was on 2025-02-07 and was classified NAI.

Our position: Internal transfer can mitigate the immediate gap at Corvale East while preserving adequate supply at Corvale General and Lakeside. No clinical changes are proposed; dosing decisions remain with treating clinicians and the committee.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 17 vials of sufentanil citrate 50 mcg/mL 1 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval and a DEA Form 222 or CSOS order for the Schedule II product.
2. Reassess days of supply at all three sites after transfer — requires pharmacy director approval.
3. Continue monitoring FDA shortage status and manufacturer communications — requires pharmacy buyer approval.

Not recommended: Purchasing from secondary distributors at inflated prices; initiating alternative opioid protocols without committee review; transferring stock from Corvale Lakeside at this time.
